confidence_notes: Numbeo's Tangier price data was updated 15 October 2026, so it is a proxy for the July window. Its MAD-to-USD conversion feed was dated 27 December 2025, making USD conversions approximate. No cocktail or restaurant wine-glass price was found; those anchors are estimated at about 1.7x and 1.0x the reported draft-beer price. Hostel averages exclude taxes and fees and use a small dorm sample; a modest fee allowance was added. The basic-room estimate uses lower-priced hotel and guesthouse data.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; anchors rely on Tangier price data and accommodation aggregates.
